content.title: Vado Corp Appoints Amanda Edris as Financial Officer
content.summary: Vado ( (VADP) ) has issued an update. Vado Corp. has appointed Amanda Edris as its new principal financial officer and executive officer following the resignation of Steve Dang. Edris, who has a robust background in finance, including roles at Ontic and Willis Lease Aerospace, will bring her expertise to the company, having previously served as its Controller. Her appointment was made without any external arrangements or related party transactions. Find detailed analytics on VADP stock on TipRan
